calls.statement: SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) dist, max(fs.etl_loaded_at) last_load, sum(fs.closing_units) units
FROM fact_stock_week fs WHERE fs.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS week_ending, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.store_key = 30 AND f.product_key = 11 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name, fs.week_ending_date, fs.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
